mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a possible solution for development problems of most of the third world countries, including Nigeria."
productive cooperative is a possible solution for development problems of most of the third world countries, including Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means a firm controls all of these components, from raw materials to final delivery."
Balanced vertical integration means a firm controls all of these components, from raw materials to final delivery.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the per unit cost of production at each output level."
Average cost (AC) is the per unit cost of production at each output level.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a limited market for goods manufactured by a cooperative, insufficient managerial expertise and lack of capital."
Additional problems are a limited market for goods manufactured by a cooperative, insufficient managerial expertise and lack of capital.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an enterprise which develops its activities on the basis of cooperative principles and which is engaged in various types of industrial productions or the supply of various services."

A labour cooperative is an enterprise which develops its activities on the basis of cooperative principles and which is engaged in various types of industrial productions or the supply of various services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a market situation where there is only one firm in an industry producing a product for which there are no close substitutes."
Monopoly is a market situation where there is only one firm in an industry producing a product for which there are no close substitutes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a result of joint action by a number of independent primaries and/or secondary and/or tertiary cooperatives."
A federation is a result of joint action by a number of independent primaries and/or secondary and/or tertiary cooperatives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rate of change in total cost (TC) as a result of a unit change in output (quantity, Q)."
The marginal cost is the rate of change in total cost (TC) as a result of a unit change in output (quantity, Q).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a purchase of smaller firm by a larger one."
Acquisition usually refers to a purchase of smaller firm by a larger one.
